name: Stream-ordered allocation vector add
description: A trivial elementwise vector add driven two ways -- classic cudaMalloc/cudaFree vs. stream-ordered cudaMallocAsync/cudaFreeAsync memory-pool allocation on a non-blocking stream.
output_description: CUDA executable writes numeric output to output/cuda_output.txt.

performance.notes: Runtime logs are written by tools/benchmark_case.py.

extraction_notes: vectorAddGPU reproduced verbatim from NVIDIA/cuda-samples streamOrderedAllocation.cu. Host driver (both classic cudaMalloc and stream-ordered cudaMallocAsync paths), gen_a/gen_b, CMakeLists, and Python oracle are new. Requires CUDA 11.2+. Snapshot sk-12.
notes: Real-extraction stream-ordered allocation case from collection snapshot sk-12. nelem=1048576, small integer inputs. Output = stream-ordered path's result; exact oracle. Requires CUDA 11.2+.
